key_structures: Jogulamba Sanctum surrounded by water pool
Nava Brahma Temples complex (9 distinct 7th-century shrines)
special_features: Fierce yet benevolent depiction of Goddess Jogulamba with hair flowing like flame, scorpions, lizards, and skulls, seated on a corpse
Sanctum cooled by an enclosed water channel to pacify tremendous ugra energy
Superb Chalukyan sandstone lattice windows and curvilinear rekha shikharas
renovation_history: Original 7th-century Chalukyan temple destroyed by Bahmani sultans in 1390 CE; the deity was sheltered safely inside Bala Brahma temple; a magnificent new temple was rebuilt in 2005 CE.
